question: In which month, Hiroshima Day is observed across the world?
solution:
The correct answer is __**August**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Every year August 6 is observed as Hiroshima Day to mark the atomic bombing of Japanese cities during World War II.
 
• The first nuclear bomb was dropped over Hiroshima on August 6, 1945, & 3 days later the second bomb was dropped over Nagasaki killing millions of people in an instant.
 
• Hiroshima Day is observed every year to remind the world about the devastating results of nuclear weapons.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• On 6 August 1945, an American aircraft, B-29 Bomber, dropped Little Boy on Hiroshima, reportedly killing 90,000 people instantly.
 
• Three days later, another B-29 aircraft dropped Fat Man on Nagasaki.
 
• The day is observed every year as a reminder of the brutal killings of innocent civilians.
 
• The day plays a key role in making anti-war and anti-nuclear policies a priority in international relationships.
